changes: Crowding = monthly boardings minus alightings along the GTFS stop order, scaled by 1/coverage and scheduled trips per hour (src/model/crowding.py).

Day types: each route-hour's monthly profile is scaled to weekdays / Saturdays / Sundays+holidays by the B2 demand model (hierarchical Poisson-Gamma smoothing of boardings per route, stop, hour and day type; src/ml/demand.py), chosen over gradient boosting on a held-out week (src/ml/compare_models.py).
Low confidence: < 2 scheduled buses/day in the hour or < 30 ticketed passengers in the month for that route-hour.

Stop busyness = tickets boarding/alighting at the stop (all routes) per hour of ticket purchase, scaled by 1/coverage/days, then by the network day-type factor of that hour. Alighting hour = purchase hour.
Route shapes simplified (Douglas-Peucker, 4 m, 5 dp) by the API server; vehicle ids of live buses replaced with hashes.
